scenes.title: What the model learns
scenes.viewerPurpose: The useful question becomes what the training process is actually being rewarded for learning.
scenes.composition: Open a source-inspired book beside a pencil and examples, establishing the reading invitation. Reveal an adjustable numerical mechanism connected to a prediction. Reveal a score target and question marker, separating an assigned target from useful learning.

scenes.title: Keep the test sealed
scenes.viewerPurpose: A score earns trust only when evaluation has stayed outside the choices it judges.
scenes.composition: Compare an exposed practice answer sheet with an unopened test envelope. Separate the Training and Validation sheets from the sealed Test. Keep the test boundary intact and reveal Unseen cases, without inventing scores or performance data.

scenes.title: Context or learned weights
scenes.viewerPurpose: That explains why giving a model context differs from teaching it new weights.
scenes.composition: Follow inputs through an adjustable weight array toward a prediction; show an error return link. Set the adjustment pencil aside while a new input passes through the same weights. Reveal a separate context board alongside the fixed weights, making the distinction visible.

scenes.title: Choose the next experiment
scenes.viewerPurpose: Start with the apprentice, then keep the sealed test beside each new model.
scenes.composition: Reveal evidence, uncertainty and consequence objects with distinct meanings. Point to the missing ingredient rather than implying a bigger model is always the solution. Return to the book and the unopened test envelope as the reading route begins.
